card.name: Small words before medical procedures or findings
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as a, or, and, include, or recurrent, right before a diagnostic test, treatment or symptom noun in descriptive medical text about diseases.

modes.label: Article before a test or treatment
modes.description: The word a comes right before a procedure or treatment such as brace, bone scan or physical exam.
modes.example: Scheuermann's disease is treated with<< a>> brace and physical therapy.

modes.label: Linker inside a list of findings
modes.description: A word like and, or, include, recurrent or multiple sits in a list of symptoms, tests or complications.
modes.example: Symptoms of acute leukemia may include excessive bruising, bleeding, and<< recurrent>> infections.

card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the model expects the name of a test, treatment or symptom.
evidence: Scheuermann's disease is treated with<< a>> brace and physical therapy.
